Module dev.metaschema.cli.processor
Package dev.metaschema.cli.processor

Class CLIProcessor

java.lang.Object
dev.metaschema.cli.processor.CLIProcessor
public class CLIProcessor extends Object
Processes command line arguments and dispatches called commands.

This implementation make significant use of the command pattern to support a delegation chain of commands based on implementations of ICommand.

    • CLIProcessor

      public CLIProcessor(@NonNull String exec, @NonNull Map<String,dev.metaschema.core.util.IVersionInfo> versionInfos, @Nullable @NotOwning PrintStream outputStream)
      The main entry point for CLI processing.

      This constructor allows specifying a custom output stream for testing purposes.

      Parameters:
      exec - the command name
      versionInfos - the version info to display when the version option is provided
      outputStream - the output stream to write to, or null to use the default console. The caller retains ownership of this stream and is responsible for closing it.
